# Widget Pricing (2025 Edition)

> This document is superseded. See Widget Pricing version 2.0.0.

## Standard pricing

The standard widget unit price is 39 credits per widget. This was the price
throughout 2025 and is retained only so that superseded-policy retrieval can be
exercised against a document that is topically identical to the current one.
